mu_name_from: MuMain loads MODEL_SYLPHID_RAY_* from Data/Player/HDK_BootMale03.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp:222-232; the helm is HDK_HelmMale 3). MU's number 31. Ours is *Male32 by the index-plus-one rule; MU never loads a *Male32 file.
why_this_one: The Muse Elf's level-380 set, Kanturu's gear (the user, 2026-10-22: 'lets now cook kanturu weapons and armors', dormant until Kanturu drops them).

stats.note: The item's own row: OpenMU's Season 6 initialiser (Season 2's level-380 sets; 0.75 and 0.95d have none).
stats.drops_from_monsters_note: Drops in Kanturu only (the user, 2026-10-25: "The 380 gear", "Kanturu only"): sim::kanturuGear keeps anything asking level 380 to the maps whose rules drop kanturu_gear. Its drop level is MU's.
stats.requires_note: MU asks level 380 (OpenMU's levelRequirement), and so does ours (the user, 2026-10-25: "Level 380"): found in the Ruins from 320, worn from 380. The stat columns are raw, scaled by the drop level as every item's.
stats.class_level_note: The Muse Elf's alone: OpenMU's elfClassLevel 2. sim::fits asks Wearer::second (docs/game/second-class-gear.md).

sheet_from: MuMain/src/bin/Data/Player, decoded with pipeline/decode_texture.py under a sylphid_ prefix (MU's names -- upper_s, lower_s, helmet_s -- are too generic to keep in content/textures): lilac and silver plate with gold, over a bare-skinned suit trimmed in lace (sal_s), black mesh stockings, and two translucent veil cards, upperta_s.OZT and lowerta_1.OZT, cut by their own alpha (62% and 17% away); level_man033 her head and hair, Red Spirit's.
material_note: painted_steel with the cast grain for the plate, as her Red Spirit; sal_s her skin; lower_s (skin, stockings and lace) leather, as Red Spirit's undersuit; the veils cloth; level_man033 hair. sal_s is not named skin*/level*/hair*, so a plus shines on it as on the plate (content::Material::skinSheet reads the name): ours, left.
material_overrides_note: painted_steel's own grain is a blade's, brushed along V; on plate it drew vertical streaks (studio, 2026-10-04). plate_steel's cast grain instead, the paint left as it is.
effects_note: MuMain has no render arm for MODEL_SYLPHID_RAY_* (no glow, no chrome pass). Its +10 boots' green (0, 0.32, 0.24) set aura (ZzzCharacter.cpp:11004-11030) is not built: fx/set_shine has no 380 sets yet.
